en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a street scene in Bruges with Gothic-style buildings behind an iron fence. To the right is an ornate, chapel-like structure with pointed arches and tracery; in the center stands a larger historic mansion with turrets, known as the Gruuthuse, and in the foreground several women in long dresses walk along the street. Printed caption text appears at the top.
